description: A polymorphic, zero-allocation mathematical formula engine and visual curve editing suite for Unity. Features 7 built-in progression models (Linear, Exponential, Power, Asymptotic, Segmented, Curve, Constant), polymorphic [SerializeReference] containers without forced ScriptableObject asset dependencies, card-style inspector drawers with instant anti-aliased curve preview popups, and live crosshair sampling.
